brief: 3-5 candidate geological hypotheses not yet tried, each naming layers / physical signature / why it catches an uncatalogued fault / how it differs from anything implemented, ranked by expected DTI improvement x implementation cost

candidates.title: Cultural-lineament veto on the LiDAR scarplet channel (canals, roads, field edges, mine benches)
candidates.signature: near-1.0 doubled-angle orientation coherence over a 1.5 km corridor x near-constant amplitude along strike x flat setting x no upward-continued magnetic gradient
candidates.why_off_catalogue: a canal or a section-line road cuts a real 0.3-1.5 m step that no photogeologist mapped as a fault; removing them raises credit per emitted dot, which is the only currency the metric pays
candidates.differs: no lane in the family ever built a cultural mask (verified: exactly one prose mention across the corpus), and all prior LiDAR arms consumed u8/255 weights without decoding units

candidates.title: Physical scarplet SNR + relative age from the pinned 2 m stack
layers: lidar_scarp_features_u8 (ex_max, ex_mean, step_max, lapneg_max, lappos_max, downface_max, upface_max, cross_max, relief, coh100, strike, valid)
candidates.signature: amplitude(m/m) / 20 km-block robust background = SNR; scarp fill fraction = mean/max; relative age = cross-face gradient / mean adjacent surface gradient; crest x toe LoG sharpness
candidates.why_off_catalogue: a fresh, through-cutting scarplet on a Holocene fan is young displacement that a regional compilation below its inclusion threshold never carried
candidates.differs: fill-fraction and block-robust SNR constructions exist nowhere else in the family; prior arms used the max bands only
candidates.expected_gain: measured: 2.08x over mass-matched random off-catalogue; 1.46x on the holdout

candidates.title: Steger sub-pixel ridges + Frangi 2-20 m Hessian lines on the slope-detrended 1 m surface
layers: USGS 3DEP 1 m tiles (706 of 716 pinned by the competition DEM-links inventory) - NOT in this checkout
candidates.signature: sub-pixel parabolic ridge offset normal to the lineament + multiscale lineness at 2/5/10/20 m on the detrended surface
candidates.why_off_catalogue: the scarps the 100 m stack averages away are exactly the meter-scale breaks a mapper walks and adds
candidates.differs: never attempted footprint-wide here; the two committed 3 m pilot tiles make a scaled-down version possible
candidates.expected_gain: unknown; the ceiling case for this lane
candidates.cost: BLOCKED: needs one Actions bridge run, no data egress in this sandbox

candidates.title: Pluvial shoreline veto (Lahontan / Bonneville) by contour-parallelism and elevation banding
layers: lidar_scarp_features_u8 (relief, strike, height implied by step_max)
candidates.signature: long scarp whose strike tracks the local contour and whose elevation falls in a discrete shoreline band
candidates.why_off_catalogue: shorelines are the second mimic named in the stack's own caveats and they are abundant on the basin floors where faults are absent
candidates.differs: the chi lane masked playas by raised_n counts; nobody masked shorelines geometrically

candidates.title: Geo-energy convergence: geodetic strain x thermal x conductivity x seismicity
layers: official training_features bands geod_shearrate, geod_dilaterate, geod_2ndinv, cond_surf, depth_to_base_surf, deq_n100a15 (418 MB, not in checkout; mirrored+parted upstream)
GDR 1391 2 m temperature probes and palaeogeothermal grids (zips ARE committed)
candidates.signature: an active extensional fault co-fires four independent anomalies
candidates.why_off_catalogue: this is the only evidence family that does not depend on the existing compilation at all
candidates.differs: no artifact in 60+ sibling repos has used the geo-energy layers end to end
candidates.expected_gain: largest ceiling (board top 0.4133 is 0.14 above the family best)
candidates.cost: high; needs the training_features mirror restored and one bridge run
